title: Usefulness First — Open YTIntel and Know What Matters Now
summary: YTIntel now prioritises repeat creator usefulness over marketing. The home experience combines current market opportunity, tracked competitor changes, personal Creator Loop evidence, saved production ideas and the next useful actions, with one-click intelligence refresh and marketing moved into a secondary share kit.
discord_changes: Added a Today creator brief that combines the strongest market opportunity, competitor movement, personal channel-fit evidence and the next actions worth taking.
Added Refresh My Intelligence: one click refreshes tracked competitors plus the saved creator niche without forcing users through separate tools.
Added Watchtower change history, Personal Fit summaries and a Production Queue so YTIntel becomes more useful every time a creator comes back.
changes: Rebuilt the Smart Start home experience around daily creator usefulness rather than the sales story.
Added a Today brief with the top current market opportunity, most relevant tracked-competitor change and personal channel-fit signal.
Added a deterministic next-action plan that changes with workspace state: setup, refresh, market research, packaging, production, outcome measurement or Idea Vault review.
Added Refresh My Intelligence. From the home screen, YTIntel can scan all saved competitor channels and refresh the saved creator niche without navigating away.
Added persistent Watchtower snapshots so repeat refreshes can compare what changed rather than only showing a fresh list.
Added change detection for new competitor uploads, newly verified 1.5x+ channel-relative breakouts, strongest tracked outlier and fastest observed view movement between snapshots.
Added a Personal Fit panel using measured Creator Loop public outcomes. Repeated mechanisms only surface after at least two measured tests and the UI keeps small-sample warnings intact.
Added a Production Queue on the home screen for saved Idea Vault research, with Watch → Shortlist → Build → Published progression.
Added a 60-second workspace setup for channel/workspace name, niche and direct competitors so the product can reuse context every session.
Simplified the default home page by hiding overlapping legacy dashboards while preserving the deeper Research OS behind an explicit advanced toggle.
Kept the one-input launcher so a pasted YouTube video routes to Deep Analyse and a typed topic routes to full Research Sprint automatically.
Moved marketing copy into a secondary Share / Marketing Kit modal so the product experience remains usefulness-first.
Preserved Opportunity Radar, winner-vs-control validation, channel-baseline caps, Always-On analysis, Packaging Lab originality guardrails, Idea Vault and Creator Loop evidence rules.
why_it_matters: Creators are more likely to keep using and paying for a product that becomes useful on every return visit. v0.24 turns YTIntel into a repeat-use workspace: refresh current evidence, see what changed, decide what deserves production time, move ideas forward and learn from measured outcomes without relearning the app each session.
